verdict.rationale: Pinecone's first-party docs describe native full-text search inside the index: BM25 token matching with Lucene query syntax over schema text fields, needing no model. The same index can also serve semantic and sparse-vector search, selected via score_by. A community comment mentions the combined keyword+vector search, but only in general terms. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of full-text/BM25 quality and depth, and documentation of limits such as tokenization or language support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run keyword/full-text search over documents inside the database without bolting on a separate search engine

citations.quote: Full-text search is BM25 token matching with Lucene query syntax over text fields in your schema... No model required
A single index can serve full-text search (BM25 with Lucene queries), semantic search, and sparse-vector search together, often covering what previously required two indexes.
When you search, you rank results via `score_by`: `text` (BM25), `query_string` (Lucene), `dense_vector`, or `sparse_vector`.
